mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 53 degrees under overcast skies at Verona City Hall. If you are looking to the stars tonight, the ISS will be visible for 6 minutes starting at 8:23 PM, traveling from Cross Plains toward Madison and reaching halfway up the sky.
Regarding city news, there was a police incident on September 10th at a residence on Hunter's Cove Way involving an attempted burglary and a recovered firearm.

There is plenty to do, starting with Yoga at Insight Wellness today. Tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at various spots including Hop Haus, Lake Lou-ee, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music and the farmer's market.
On September 10th, Verona officers responded to a burglary in progress on Hunter's Cove Way. A 19 year old suspect was taken into custody with a handgun recovered at the scene.
Culver's is currently closed for a remodel and will open today at 10:00 AM. They will be serving their flavor of the day once they are back in action.
